Dead Meat S1 EP5 - Buddy and the Bear
programmes.description: It's the bear opener in Minnesota and Buddy Toepfer has waited five years for the chance to shoot a big one. And Buddy's got a buddy who just happens to have a bear or two on his property. Find out if Buddy gets his wish. Also, experience the camaraderie of a Minnesota bear camp and see if some of the lesser bear parts are fit to eat.

programmes.title: Dead Meat S1 EP6 - Uncommon Carp
programmes.description: Scott gets back together with a few good friends in search of some of the lesser-eaten fish in the Sacramento River delta - common carp. They've got a reputation for being slimy, foul smelling fish that no one wants to eat. We're bow fishing with Matt Lauchland and Kevin Phillips from Michael David Winery for common carp.

programmes.title: Dead Meat S1 EP7 - Florida Gator Hunt
programmes.description: Florida is a prime location for the Dead Meat show. The state is loaded with invasive creatures like lionfish, snakeheads, pythons and iguanas. And they have a few alligators as well. The country surrounding the fisherman's paradise of Lake Okeechobee is home to more than a couple gators. Scott Leysath has cooked lots of gator meat, but this is his first hunt.

programmes.title: Dead Meat S1 EP8 - Indiana Trapping Show
programmes.description: It’s the deer season opener in Indiana, but the Dead Meat team is after something a little less conventional. Scott joins master trapper Cal Dittmar in search of water going muskrats, and hopefully a beaver or two, or three. Cal’s mother hosts a non-conventional holiday feast with muskrat front and center. And if the muskrat isn’t enough for you, who’s hungry for a little coyote burger.

Man Eats Wild S1 EP5 - Heartbreak Tuna
programmes.description: When two oceans collide, there is mayhem on the horizon. On this episode Mario ventures off the coast of Cape Town where the Indian ocean meets the Atlantic. The two colliding water temperatures and currents causes the yellow fin tuna to come in hordes and he finds himself in a David vs Goliath battle with his food. It is of the upmost importance than he can select his fish and only one at a time line caught, which sounds easy in theory.... but nature has something else in mind for him.

programmes.title: Man Eats Wild S1 EP6 - Getting Close to Black Death
programmes.description: Deep in the wilderness of Northern South Africa, poaching is rife, and the wilderness is as dangerous as it gets. Mario attempts to be the first person in the area to have ever harvested one of the most dangerous animals known to Africa, the Cape buffalo also known by locals as "Black Death". By risking his life Mario is determined to harvest this beast so he can donate the meat to the Anti-poaching units who are on the front line, saving endangered animals daily. As most of the bounty is used to feed the conservationists, he reserves a shank for himself as he is keen to create a hearty dish of Osso Bucco.

programmes.description: The Axis deer populations in Hawaii have reached plague proportions and they are in-fact invasive to this beautifully pristine archipelago of the pacific. Luckily for Mario these deer also happen to boast the best tasting venison that the wild can produce. He teams up with big wave surfer Shane Dorian who is also a huge advocate for harvesting food from the wild. The two go out and face some of the toughest conditions as the deer swarm the mountain tops of Hawaii in huge numbers making it almost impossible to approach. In the end its all worth it as Mario and Shane have some fun on the grill all whilst doing their part in helping to lessen the population of this invasive species.
